Name: Chaos Burst
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can choose from the following effects for each slot level above 1st:
• 1d6 extra damage of the type rolled.
• You may roll an additional d8 - it is not added to the damage, but you may use the result to determine the damage type.
• The spell targets one additional creature, firing an additional bolt toward them. This second bolt requires its own damage roll and may have a different damage type.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
